holidays.name: Maha Shivratri
holidays.note: Since the 02 (Two) Festival Holidays namely Id-ul-Fitr (22nd April 2023) and Lakshmi Puja (28th October 2023) fall on 4th Saturday, Category B employees can avail two additional festival holidays -- Milad-un-Nabi or Id-e-Milad (Birthday of Prophet Mohammad) on 28th September 2023 (Thursday) and Maha Shivratri on 18th February 2023 (Saturday) -- to maintain the total number of Public/Closed/Festival holidays to 18. (Note: 'Milad-un-Nabi or Id-e-Milad' is referenced here as an RH being promoted to FH, but that name does not appear as its own row in the printed 35-row RH list on pages 2-3 of this circular -- an apparent inconsistency in the source document itself, not corrected here.)

policyNotes.text: Muslim festivals, not falling on the notified dates due to non-sighting of moon, will be observed as per the Government guidelines.
For availing Restricted Holidays, concerned employees shall have to exercise their option by 31st January 2023 and obtain approval of their controlling officer before availing the same.

All employees (including non-executive trainees) can avail a compensatory off against not spared Closed/Public/Festival/Restricted holiday(s) within two (02) months in the same calendar year. Category A [Executives (both Works and Non-Works)], Category C [Industrial non-executives (Works & Non-Works)] and Category D (non-executive trainees) employees can avail a compensatory off against each Public/Closed holiday coinciding with their weekly off (including Sunday). Category C [Industrial non-executives (Works & Non-Works)] employees who will not be spared, or do not want to avail Closed/Public Holidays on Republic Day, May Day, Independence Day and Mahatma Gandhi's Birthday, will have the following option: claiming Compensatory off within 2 months in the same calendar year, or Extra wages. This option is also available if any of the aforesaid holidays coincides with their weekly off (excluding Sunday); in case of Sunday weekly-off, only Compensatory off is admissible.

Employees joining services of the company during the calendar year will be entitled for proportionate Restricted Holiday(s), to be calculated on half-yearly or quarterly basis with reference to their joining date, as the case may be.
